why_not_ollama: Ollama is not installed on this host; llama-server is the only receiver. collect.detect_receiver() selects the adapter by probing /props.
decision_attach_not_launch: Attach to the resident, idle Qwen2.5-3B server. Its build matches the pinned manifest; swap is 25.3/26.6 GB so a new receiver cannot be loaded; attaching avoids touching another session's processes.
model_digest_verification: independent shasum -a 256 of the resolved file == collect.LlamaServer.metadata() live digest (MATCH)

decoding_required.note: num_ctx is fixed by the server at 8192 per slot; the adapter fails closed on any other value. temperature/top_p match the theory workstream's config and the sibling project's measured regime, so earlier calibration transfers.

cache_prompt_reason: prompt caching changes batch composition and llama.cpp does not guarantee bit-reproducibility across it; restored branches must not differ because one hit the cache
template_injection: The server chat template injects 'You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.' when no system message is sent. Verified via /apply-template (renders without generating) that an explicit system message replaces it completely. collect.initial_messages() always sends collect.SYSTEM, so the injected default never reaches the receiver.
max_tokens_per_call_reason: The mock config's 32 would truncate essentially every code answer. Measured completions on this receiver and task family: median 67, p90 164-176, max 253 tokens (docs/measured_calibration.md, docs/pilot_findings.md). 512 clears the observed maximum with 2x margin; run() still enforces the cap and records length-truncated replies via done_reason.
per_chunk_guard: Record /props build_info, model_path and per-slot n_ctx at the start and end of every run (run() already calls metadata before and after); halt on any change.
throughput_planning: 909 multi-turn calls/hour on this receiver under contention (docs/pilot_findings.md); the 168-call development ceiling is ~11 minutes of generation.
not_yet_done: No generation call has been made through this adapter. The first is the frozen development release, per the protocol's rule that a clean committed freeze and measured preflight precede calls.
